after_investment.notes: A 2025 press item says Gjirafa received USD 8.7m from Rockaway across two rounds (https://startupsmagazine.co.uk/article-rockaway-ventures-closes-second-fund-nearly-55m); that source attributes it to Rockaway Ventures although the investments were made by Rockaway Capital in 2016 and 2019. Gjirafa is described there as one of Rockaway's most successful investments.

caveats: T0 entity is Rockaway Capital (2016); Rockaway Ventures fund did not exist then. Count it as a Rockaway group investment.
